item.description: Cold Chisel is pleased to announce that final production mapping has allowed some additional tickets to be released for sale today – Tuesday, 1 October – right before The Big Five-0 Tour kicks off. item.description: Melbourne review wrap: Cold Chisel at Flemington Racecourse Well, that was emotional. item.title: COLD CHISEL - THE BIG FIVE-0 TOUR ENDS WITH A BANG / LITHOGRAPH & MERCH RANGE RELEASED ONLINE - Cold Chisel
item.description: Last night COLD CHISEL wrapped up the Australian leg of their Big Five-0 tour at the QUDOS Bank Arena in Sydney – and wow, what a freakin’ tour! item.title: Cold Chisel: The Big Five-0 - Channel 7 Premiere - Cold Chisel
item.description: 50 Years of Hits. One unforgettable story. Cold Chisel: The Big Five-O celebrates five decades of anthems that defined Australian music, from Khe Sanh to Standing On The Outside and Flame Trees. Crank it loud and relive the soundtrack of a nation. 8.00pm Sunday, 11 May on Seven and 7plus.
